subject: Post-call: schedule technical deep-dive (60–90m) & align agenda — CloudWay
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cloudway.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: schedule technical deep-dive (60–90m) & align agenda — CloudWay

Thanks again for the call this morning — great conversation and clear fit on latency/cost concerns for your search/retrieval pipeline. Quick recap and immediate next steps:

- Goal: 60–90m technical deep-dive with our ML + infra leads to validate throughput targets, data handling, and rollout options.
- Outcome we want: sample latency/cost projection for your 300k monthly queries and alignment on authentication/audit needs.

Can you confirm who from your side should join (ML lead + infra/SRE ideally)? We want the folks who own the production rollout + the engineer who owns the evaluation tests.

Proposed 60–90 minute slots (all PST):
- Wed Nov 18 10:00–11:30
- Thu Nov 19 13:00–14:30
- Fri Nov 20 09:00–10:30

If none of those work, please share 2 preferred windows and we’ll lock. Attached is a short prelim agenda (tdx-prelim-agenda.pdf) and a mutual action plan spreadsheet for the engagement (mutual-action-plan.xlsx).

Draft agenda highlights (we can tweak):
1) 10m — Introductions & success criteria
2) 20m — Your workload profile and SLOs (latency, qps, burst)
3) 25m — Redwood serving architecture and routing/fallback options (runtime + quantization tradeoffs)
4) 20–35m — Live profile mapping: sequence-length distribution + cost projection + Q&A
5) 5–10m — Immediate next steps & owner alignment

Marissa — looping you in to coordinate engineers for the run-through and to own the pre-call artifacts. Ben — FYI on any ops constraints that might affect slot selection (reserved capacity windows).

Jordan / Samantha — quick yes/no on slot preference today? If you prefer a timezone-lift, we can propose equivalent ET/UTC times.

Thanks,

Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: tdx-prelim-agenda.pdf (1 page), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cloudway.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@cloudway.io>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: schedule technical deep-dive (60–90m) & align agenda — CloudWay

Naomi — thanks for the recap and the agenda. Quick answers:
- Attendees: myself (product), Samantha Ortiz (SRE lead), and Miguel Torres (ML infra — will invite). Miguel is the one who runs our model evaluation infra.
- Preferred slot: Wed Nov 18 10:00–11:30 PST works best for us.

A few asks from our side to add to the agenda if possible:
- Brief note on data retention and audit log formats (we have compliance checks).
- Call out any pre-run artifacts you need from us (sample payloads, schema, QPS trace).

On the sheet — I’ll add Miguel’s contact and a short note on compliance items.

On Wed we’ll have Miguel share a brief infra diagram during the call. Confirmed for 11/18. Thanks.

— Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Product, CloudWay
jordan.lee@cloudway.io | +1 650-777-8899

Pre-call asks (short):
- Please upload a 30–60s QPS trace and a representative sample payload to the shared drive by EOD Tue 11/17. If you can’t, paste a short sequence-length distribution in the spreadsheet.
- Compliance note: we’ll include a 5–7 minute run-through on audit logs and retention; Ben will cover integration points.

I attached an updated prelim agenda (tdx-prelim-agenda.pdf) with the two extra bullets (compliance + pre-run artifacts) and updated the mutual-action-plan.xlsx with Miguel’s name and an initial owner column.

Marissa — please send the invite and include 'Zoom + passcode' and mark the invite as 90 minutes to allow flexibility. Ben — any operational blackout windows we should avoid?

Jordan / Miguel / Samantha — thanks — see you Wed.

Quick operational note — thanks for locking the time. Two small asks from infra ops:
- Please avoid scheduling any heavy batch jobs against the dedicated eval cluster between 09:30–12:00 PST on 11/18; we’re running a routine capacity test that morning. The call at 10:00 is fine — just want to avoid conflicting runs if Miguel plans to do live tests.
- We’ll add a short slide explaining how our autoscaling and batching knobs map to cost — useful for your budget conversation.

Marissa — will be ready to present those ops knobs. Naomi — happy to join the call for the cost mapping portion.

Cheers,
